title.zh: AlphaForge：我和 Agent 在 BRAIN 上做 Alpha 研究
title.en: AlphaForge: alpha research with an agent

summary.zh: 从在平台上一个个手动提交 alpha，到在 VSCode 里交给 Agent 跑完整的自动化工作流，再到按经济含义做分类分析。一份关于操作方法的记录。
summary.en: From submitting alphas by hand, to letting an agent drive the whole pipeline from VSCode, to classifying results by economic meaning. A record of the method.
